_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: apple-asc
description: App Store Connect from the developer's perspective, as separate skills plus an always-on rule: asc-api.skill.md (the default path - ASC REST API with a team key: listings, screenshots, builds, pricing, age rating, review submission, TestFlight, review-time editability, policy quirks), browserctl.asc.skill.md (browserctl-driven flows the API cannot reach: App Privacy questionnaire, EU DSA trader status, agreements, IAP setup, API-key creation), asc-upload.skill.md (archive + upload a build from the command line), and asc.rule.md (API-first routing, outward-action confirmation, secrets/session discipline). Field-tested on iOS and macOS app publishes. The browser skill follows the browserctl.<site> extension-skill format and requires the base browserctl plugin in the same project.

notes: The browser skill requires the base browserctl plugin attached to the same project; the API skill needs an ASC team API key recorded in ai/.memory/credentials.md (creating one is a browser flow - see browserctl.asc.skill.md).
The signed-in Apple session lives in a browserctl profile: log in once headed (2FA needs the owner); the session persists in the profile and nowhere else.

resources.name: asc_browser_profile
resources.prompt: browserctl profile that holds (or will hold) the signed-in Apple/ASC session
